boundaries.name: rust_and_compiler_refinement
boundaries.obligation: Handwritten declarations and source intervals have not been proved equivalent to Rust, compiler output, target indices, memory allocation, panic/resource behavior or built CircuitData. Std-only Lean does not execute Plonky2.

boundaries.name: native_word_domains_and_codec
boundaries.obligation: Rust u32/u64/U256, PoseidonHashOut, Bytes32, Tx and PrivateState codecs must refine decoded Nat fields with actual field canonicality and ordered BE u32 limbs; native input typing and target allocation checks are distinct. Transfer tokenIndex range is not assumed from allocation.

boundaries.name: field_and_local_gadget_lowering
boundaries.obligation: For the concrete built constructor, field equality/is_equal/add_const/range_check, split_le(height32), and sub_u32 gates must extract RawCircuitGates, including8 LSB-first local borrow equations, canonical ranges, initial/final borrow0 and actual output wiring. The Lean bridge proves aggregate no-underflow from those equations; it does not assume it.

boundaries.name: scoped_asset_merkle_paths
boundaries.obligation: For each concrete visited tree/path/key/input/output tuple, supply PathContractAt under actual leaf hashing, bit ordering and collision resistance. No global all-AssetMap exact opening or injective finite-root assumption is used. The old authenticated private-state root must encode the initial tree.

boundaries.name: scoped_sent_tx_merkle_path
boundaries.obligation: Supply SentPathContractAt only for this concrete nonce, empty leaf, old sent tree and newly formed Tx. Imported path-height, bit ordering and hash semantics must justify the specific equality/replacement premise, not assume arbitrary global replay exclusion.

boundaries.name: ordered_transfer_tree_and_private_hash
boundaries.obligation: Imported native/circuit64-leaf transfer roots,25-word leaf codec,21-word PrivateState commitment, padding/default Tx and shared native-target hash semantics need separate source/gadget proofs. Private commitment authenticity is not inferred from a bare Hash4 value.

boundaries.name: native_nonce_build_profile
boundaries.obligation: Rust nonce+1 u32 overflow behavior depends on compilation overflow settings; the model explicitly parameterizes checked/wrapping. Correspondence with field add_const is proved only when nonce+1<2^32 and fieldOrder>=2^32; source itself has no extra nonce overflow circuit assertion.

boundaries.name: witness_assignment_and_proof_backend
boundaries.obligation: PartialWitness setters, field conversions, generator execution, circuit build/prove/verify and public-input integrity remain external. Wrapper success forces modeled native admission but does not establish trusted verification keys or soundness of a supplied serialized CircuitData.

boundaries.name: serialization_codec_and_trust
boundaries.obligation: CircuitData AllGate/AllGenerator serialization and bincode serde implementation are opaque delegated operations. from_bytes ignores consumed byte count and does not add a trust check; no exact-end decoding, canonical serialization, or authenticated circuit provenance is claimed.

boundaries.name: consumer_and_protocol_scope
boundaries.obligation: Spend reports is_valid but never requires true. Consumers must establish required validity, source ownership, authenticated prior state, freshness/finality, transfer inclusion, replay/nullifier conditions and recipient rules. The proved per-token debit trace is not whole-protocol or cross-channel economic soundness.
